name: What home renovations offer the best return on investment when selling in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What home renovations offer the best return on investment when selling in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Focus on updates that enhance curb appeal and modernize essential areas. Kitchen and bathroom refreshes, painting, and landscaping often yield strong returns. Minor updates like new fixtures, fresh paint, and updated hardware can make a significant impact without requiring extensive remodeling. Kelby Contreras can advise on current buyer preferences in areas like Miami-Dade and Broward County to help prioritize these updates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom refreshes, paint, and landscaping typically offer the best return on investment when selling your home in South Florida. Minor updates can also significantly increase appeal.
